description: Find medicines with the same active substance, like /odpowiedniki on apteka.online: sold_online lists shop products with price and unit price, catalog lists the register's other brands with official refund prices, availability in pharmacies and parallel imports. Filter by dose, route, salt, excipients to avoid (e.g. laktoza; unknown composition never counts as free from it), storage and prescription status; sort by name, availability, dose, package, price or unitprice. options lists the values that exist. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.

availability.description: Catalog availability in pharmacies: withdata (default), all, 5 very good, 34 good, 2 hard to get, 1 none, nodata

dose.description: A value from options.doses, e.g. 10 mg

exclude_excipients.description: Excipients to avoid, e.g. laktoza; rows without composition data are hidden and counted

include_parallel.description: Also list parallel imports in the catalog

limit.description: Rows to return across both lists, 1 to 50, default 20

offset.description: Rows to skip, from next_offset of the previous answer

prescription.description: Catalog dispensing category: all (default), otc, rp (prescription), other (Rpz, Rpw, Lz)

query.description: Active substance, brand or Latin name, or the key from /odpowiedniki/{key}, e.g. peryndopryl or Prestarium

route.description: A value from options.routes, e.g. Doustnie

salt.description: A value from options.salts (salt or ester of the substance)

sort.description: Order, default: refunded and well available first

storage.description: Keep only these storage conditions: fridge, cool, room

name: find_equivalents
title: Medicine equivalents
